reason: The initial title/path audit exposed an inference-only false anchor and near-duplicate production changes; both corrections are general metadata rules.

deduplicate_metadata_signature.rule: Within one project, retain only the highest-ranked candidate for an identical normalized title plus identical ordered non-test runtime path tuple.

exclude_inference_only.rule: Exclude a candidate when every non-test runtime source path is under a project's explicit inference subtree and the title has no direct train/trainer/optimizer/checkpoint/backward/gradient term.

stage: after title/path audit and before body/diff/outcome/review access
